defect: The fix removes the curTextureWidth/curTextureHeight assignment on the cache-hit path that this change added, as part of a memory-leak cleanup.
reason: Setting the current texture size on a cache hit is correct (current TextureCacheCommon does exactly this), so the removal is a cleanup, not the repair of a defect.

defect: The new clipping code nudges every vertex lying exactly on a clip plane inward by w/50, distorting clipped geometry (a workaround for the pre-existing ClipToScreen scaling bug).
reason: The fix repairs ClipToScreen (pre-existing) and removes this change's w/50 nudge, which by itself produced wrong vertex positions at the clip boundaries.

defect: Refresh() calls rows_.empty() instead of rows_.clear(), so rows_ keeps pointers to views deleted by Clear() and later SetFocus() calls use freed views.
reason: The typo is in a line this change added and the fix replaces it with clear().

defect: The added else branch frees a buffer allocated with new[] using free(), a mismatched deallocation (undefined behaviour).
reason: The fix replaces the free(path) added by this change with delete[] path.

defect: The physical button labels Start and Select are routed through the same translation keys as the actions, so translated languages show the verb (e.g. the 'Select' action text) as the Select button name.
reason: The fix reverts exactly these two m->T() calls added by this change to literal button names (and adjusts layout for the longer translated text).

defect: The Windows branch declares 'mode = OPEN_EXISTING,' followed by 'const DWORD flags', a syntax error, and calls CloseHandle(_handle) on an undeclared name, breaking the Windows build.
reason: Both errors are in lines this change added and the fix ('Fix windows build') corrects them.

defect: I18NCategory::name_ becomes a non-owning const char*, but LoadIni passes iter->name().c_str() of a local IniFile section, so the name dangles after loading.
reason: The fix restores std::string name_; seeing the dangling pointer requires the LoadSection caller in i18n.cpp.

defect: __UmdReplace now calls Achievements::ChangeUMD, whose implementation (changed in the same commit) sets g_isIdentifying=true after rc_client_begin_change_media, so a synchronous or failed callback leaves execution blocked and the game hangs.
reason: The fix for the UMD-change hang rewrites the ChangeUMD call this change added (passing a file loader and setting g_isIdentifying before the request).

defect: The fix only extends the ChangeUMD declaration with a FileLoader* parameter to match the reworked implementation.
reason: The declaration added here was correct for its time; the hang came from later implementation and call-site changes (block-device file reader, g_isIdentifying ordering), not from this header line.

defect: The fix removes the extra row padding (roundH) this change added as a workaround and fixes the DXT decoder overrun at its source.
reason: Over-allocating the buffer was a harmless workaround for a pre-existing decoder overrun; removing it is cleanup alongside the real fix elsewhere.

defect: LoadAtlasMetadata, now called from UpdateTheme for the per-theme atlas, skips loading when metadata is already loaded, so switching themes keeps the old atlas metadata with the new atlas image.
reason: This change moved the lazy-load guard into a per-theme path where it is wrong; the fix ('Fix lazy loading of metadata') removes the guard.

defect: The fix extends the misaligned-vertex check from the JIT path to the interpreter path as well.
reason: The interpreter crash on misaligned data predates this change, which only added a partial mitigation; the fix widens that mitigation.

defect: ChallengeModeActive now returns rc_client_get_hardcore_enabled, and the change removed the explicit hardcore disable in Initialize, so with no login (SetGame returns early) rc_client's default hardcore=on makes challenge mode active and hides savestates.
reason: The fix adds IsLoggedIn() to the line this change wrote; knowing rc_client's default hardcore state needs the rcheevos source.

defect: The new Symbian bump allocator advances g_next_ptr (void* arithmetic) on every executable allocation and never rewinds, so re-creating the JIT runs past the 20 MB code chunk and crashes.
reason: The fix adds FreeExecutableMemory to reset g_next_ptr and makes it u8*; that executable memory is never freed on Symbian is only visible in ArmEmitter.h.

defect: The fix drops the UI/PluginScreen.h include (and adds MiscScreens.h) because PluginScreen.h was deleted later.
reason: PluginScreen.h existed when this change added the include; the fix adapts to a later file removal (2c5adc9).

defect: In the new state machine, PrepareData's 'already populated from cache' early return never sets ACTIVE, so the state stays PREPARED, the IsReady assert fails and ini-less replacements never become active.
reason: The fix adds SetState(ACTIVE) on that early return (and allows CANCEL_INIT in the assert added by this change).

defect: 'MIPSGPReg rd = _RD:' ends with a colon instead of a semicolon, breaking the ARM build.
reason: The typo is in the line this change added and the fix corrects it.

defect: The fix replaces the macOS fork/exec 'open' calls with OSXShowInFinder/OSXOpenURL to reveal files in Finder and avoid spawning processes.
reason: This change only renamed OpenDirectory/Launch* and merged them; the macOS 'open' behaviour was pre-existing.

defect: Download spawns a detached thread holding a raw 'this' while Downloader::Update (or the owner) can release the shared_ptr as soon as progress/failed is set, so the thread can use a destroyed object.
reason: The fix passes a shared_ptr to the thread to keep the object alive, repairing the lifetime bug in code this change introduced.

defect: The fix makes maxNeeded an s64 to avoid a u64-to-size_t narrowing warning on 32-bit builds.
reason: The truncation only matters for single reads larger than 4 GiB, which cannot occur for PSP images; this is a warning fix, not a practical defect.

defect: The fix moves the ID variables back into the non-clear branch and adds an IsColorTestTriviallyTrue optimisation.
reason: Hoisting the variables out of the else branch in this change did not alter the computed IDs; the fix is a refactor and an optimisation.

defect: The fix moves the lighting-enable ID bit from 19 to 24 and only rewrites this change's condition from (lightingEnable & 1) to isLightingEnabled().
reason: The line this change added (light bits also for UV gen mode 2) is only restyled by the fix; the bit move does not involve it.

defect: The fix drops the redundant '& 0xFFFFFF' mask in getRelativeAddress.
reason: All callers already pass data masked to 24 bits, so removing the mask changes nothing observable.

defect: The new FBO size heuristic (min of viewport, scissor and region) and the disabled update of v->width/height produce wrongly sized framebuffers, losing Growlanser's title screens.
reason: Four days later the same author's fix rewrites the heuristic lines this change added and re-enables the width/height update it commented out.

defect: The fix removes SetRoundingMode's 'skip when mode is 0' shortcut and always clears the rounding/FTZ bits before setting them.
reason: At this change every SetRoundingMode was preceded by ClearRoundingMode, so the shortcut was valid; it broke only after later commits (FTZ handling in 5816685, removal of the clear on ctc1 in 726cb85).

defect: The fix adds the missing <cstring> include needed for memset/strcpy.
reason: The file never included <cstring>; this change only replaced the non-existent <cmemory> with <memory>, so the missing include predates it.

defect: The fix downgrades the self-texture-copy WARN_LOG_REPORT_ONCE added here to WARN_LOG_ONCE to stop report spam.
reason: Sending a report for a normal condition is a logging/telemetry choice, not a functional defect.

defect: The depth-swizzle hack applies to any depth texture with address bits 0x200000, regardless of framebuffer format, so 16-bit framebuffers (Katamari) get a widened and wrongly swizzled texture.
reason: The fix ('Fix Katamari', same day) restricts the hack this change added to GE_FORMAT_8888; that the swizzle depends on the pixel format is PSP hardware knowledge, not visible in code.

defect: The fix adds a depthUpperBits parameter to GetDepalettizeShader and drops its internal gstate lookup.
reason: The changed signature line is touched only to add a parameter; the depthUpperBits computation it removes came from a later commit, not from this change.

defect: The new fast view/projection matrix loads loop with 'if (++i > end) break', allowing one write past the matrix and consuming one command too many.
reason: The fix changes the condition to '>=' in the loops this change added (as well as in older copies of the pattern).

defect: The fix changes ObjTypeToString's default return from "Unknown" to an empty string.
reason: This is a cosmetic change to log text, not the repair of a defect.

defect: num = iFrameSkip - 1 is zero when frameskip is 1, so 'numFrames % num' divides by zero.
reason: The line was added by this change and the fix ('Fix divide by 0 bug') replaces it.

defect: Moving the GL context to a separate render thread leaves SwapInterval calling wglSwapIntervalEXT from the emulation thread, where no context is current, so VSync no longer works.
reason: The fix routes the swap interval through the render manager next to the SetSwapFunction line this change added; seeing it requires the GPU_GLES caller of SwapInterval.

defect: The moved SubmitPrimitive loop steps with ++vtx instead of vtx += 3 (the original code used += 3), so every vertex starts a triangle and reads past the decoded vertices.
reason: The fix restores 'vtx+=3' in the loop header this change wrote.

defect: The fix adds a Lerp method and a comment to the VertexData struct for the new clipping code.
reason: This is a feature addition for polygon clipping, not the repair of a defect in the struct this change added.

defect: 'lowp vec3 unlitColor = u_matambientalpha;' assigns a vec4 uniform to a vec3, a GLSL compile error.
reason: The fix wraps it in vec3(); the same hunk uses u_matambientalpha as a vec4, so the mismatch is visible.

defect: The failure branches for pic0 and pic1 delete and null iconTexture instead of pic0Texture/pic1Texture (copy-paste error), leaking the failed texture and dropping a valid icon.
reason: The fix ('Fix copy-paste fail') corrects exactly these lines added by this change.

defect: The fix finishes the CheckBox drawing (state-dependent on/off image, new placement) and other UI style tweaks.
reason: The new UI CheckBox was an unused work-in-progress placeholder here; the fix completes the feature rather than repairing a defect.

defect: The fix makes AnalogSetupScreen::key call UIScreen::key so the screen can be navigated with a gamepad.
reason: AnalogSetupScreen::key never forwarded to UIScreen::key before this change either; the change only moved the key logging to the touch test screen.

defect: sceKernelDeleteHeap calls kernelObjects.Destroy, which already deletes the object, and then 'delete heap' again, a double free.
reason: The fix removes the extra delete added by this change; that Destroy deletes the object is in sceKernel.h.
